<!--
ATENÇÃO: protótipo. Os dados de origem (clientes_risco.json, gerado por
build_churn_data.py a partir de base_edited.parquet) já estão anonimizados
(Documento/Nome_fantasia/Vendedor), mas confirme antes de publicar fora do
ambiente interno.
-->

```{python}
#| label: setup
import json
from pathlib import Path
import uuid
import pandas as pd
import plotly.graph_objects as go
from IPython.display import HTML, display

STONE_GREEN = "#52C465"
STONE_RED   = "#FC4828"
STONE_GRAY  = "#B0B0B0"
STONE_DARK  = "#3A3A3A"

payload = json.loads(Path("clientes_risco.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
clientes = payload["clientes"]
media_tpv = payload["media_tpv_ativos_m0"]
df_rank = pd.DataFrame(clientes).sort_values("risk_score")

tpv_min, tpv_max = float(df_rank["tpv_m0"].min()), float(df_rank["tpv_m0"].max())
score_min, score_max = float(df_rank["risk_score"].min()), float(df_rank["risk_score"].max())
```

# Clientes em Risco de Churn

## Row {height="90px"}

```{python}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Mês de referência"
#| color: "#52C465"
dict(value = payload["mes_referencia"])
```

```{python}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Clientes ativos na carteira"
#| color: "#52C465"
dict(value = f"{payload['total_clientes_ativos']:,}".replace(",", "."))
```

```{python}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Score do 10º colocado (Top 10)"
#| color: "#FC4828"
dict(value = f"{df_rank['risk_score'].min():.1f}")
```

## Row {height="40px"}

```{=html}
<div class="callout-note">
⚠️ <b>Score de risco provisório</b>: regra de negócio (50% percentil de dias sem transacionar + 50% percentil da
queda de TPV vs. média dos 3 meses anteriores), calculada só entre clientes ativos — <b>não é um modelo de Machine
Learning</b>. Serve para validar este protótipo até o modelo real (treinado com <code>flag_churn</code>) ficar pronto.
</div>
```

## Row {height="680px"}

```{python}
#| title: "Top 10 — filtre e passe o mouse ou clique em um cliente para ver os detalhes ao lado"
bar_div = "bar_" + uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]

fig_bar = go.Figure(go.Bar(
    x=df_rank["risk_score"], y=df_rank["nome_fantasia"], orientation="h",
    marker_color=STONE_GRAY,
    customdata=df_rank["documento"],
    hovertemplate="<b>%{y}</b><br>Score de risco: %{x}<extra></extra>",
))
_ = fig_bar.update_layout(
    template="simple_white", margin=dict(t=10, l=10, r=10, b=10),
    xaxis_title="Score de risco (0–100)", height=520,
)
fig_bar_json = fig_bar.to_json()

clientes_json = json.dumps(clientes, ensure_ascii=False)
docs_order_json = json.dumps(df_rank["documento"].tolist())

display(HTML(f'''
<div style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:14px;margin-bottom:12px;">
  <input id="filterNome" type="text" placeholder="🔍 Filtrar por nome do cliente..."
    style="flex:1 1 100%;padding:6px 10px;border:1px solid #ccc;border-radius:6px;box-sizing:border-box;">
  <div style="flex:1 1 220px;">
    <label style="font-size:0.72rem;color:#888;">TPV do mês atual: <span id="tpvRangeLabel"></span></label>
    <div style="display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;">
      <input id="filterTpvMin" type="range" min="{tpv_min}" max="{tpv_max}" step="1" value="{tpv_min}" style="flex:1;">
      <input id="filterTpvMax" type="range" min="{tpv_min}" max="{tpv_max}" step="1" value="{tpv_max}" style="flex:1;">
    </div>
  </div>
  <div style="flex:1 1 220px;">
    <label style="font-size:0.72rem;color:#888;">Score de risco: <span id="scoreRangeLabel"></span></label>
    <div style="display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;">
      <input id="filterScoreMin" type="range" min="{score_min}" max="{score_max}" step="0.1" value="{score_min}" style="flex:1;">
      <input id="filterScoreMax" type="range" min="{score_min}" max="{score_max}" step="0.1" value="{score_max}" style="flex:1;">
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
<div id="{bar_div}" style="width:100%;height:520px;"></div>
<script>
window.__CLIENTES__ = {clientes_json};
window.__DOCS_ORDER__ = {docs_order_json};
window.__MEDIA_TPV__ = {media_tpv};
window.__ANO_YTD__ = {payload["ano_ytd"]};
window.__CURRENT_DOC__ = null;
(function() {{
  const figData = {fig_bar_json};
  const STONE_RED = "{STONE_RED}";
  const STONE_GRAY = "{STONE_GRAY}";
  let visibleDocs = window.__DOCS_ORDER__.slice();

  function fmtBRL(v) {{
    return "R$ " + Number(v).toLocaleString("pt-BR", {{maximumFractionDigits: 0}});
  }}

  function getFilteredClientes() {{
    const nome = (document.getElementById("filterNome").value || "").toLowerCase();
    const tpvMin = Math.min(parseFloat(document.getElementById("filterTpvMin").value), parseFloat(document.getElementById("filterTpvMax").value));
    const tpvMax = Math.max(parseFloat(document.getElementById("filterTpvMin").value), parseFloat(document.getElementById("filterTpvMax").value));
    const scoreMin = Math.min(parseFloat(document.getElementById("filterScoreMin").value), parseFloat(document.getElementById("filterScoreMax").value));
    const scoreMax = Math.max(parseFloat(document.getElementById("filterScoreMin").value), parseFloat(document.getElementById("filterScoreMax").value));
    document.getElementById("tpvRangeLabel").textContent = `${{fmtBRL(tpvMin)}} – ${{fmtBRL(tpvMax)}}`;
    document.getElementById("scoreRangeLabel").textContent = `${{scoreMin.toFixed(1)}} – ${{scoreMax.toFixed(1)}}`;
    return window.__CLIENTES__.filter(c =>
      c.nome_fantasia.toLowerCase().includes(nome) &&
      c.tpv_m0 >= tpvMin && c.tpv_m0 <= tpvMax &&
      c.risk_score >= scoreMin && c.risk_score <= scoreMax
    ).sort((a, b) => a.risk_score - b.risk_score);
  }}

  function paintColors() {{
    const colors = visibleDocs.map(doc => doc === window.__CURRENT_DOC__ ? STONE_RED : STONE_GRAY);
    Plotly.restyle("{bar_div}", {{"marker.color": [colors]}});
  }}

  function redraw() {{
    const filtered = getFilteredClientes();
    visibleDocs = filtered.map(c => c.documento);

    if (window.__CURRENT_DOC__ && !visibleDocs.includes(window.__CURRENT_DOC__)) {{
      window.__CURRENT_DOC__ = null;
      if (window.showEmptyCard) window.showEmptyCard();
    }}

    if (filtered.length === 0) {{
      Plotly.react("{bar_div}", [{{x: [], y: [], type: "bar", orientation: "h"}}], figData.layout, {{responsive: true, displaylogo: false}});
      return;
    }}

    const colors = visibleDocs.map(doc => doc === window.__CURRENT_DOC__ ? STONE_RED : STONE_GRAY);
    Plotly.react("{bar_div}", [{{
      x: filtered.map(c => c.risk_score),
      y: filtered.map(c => c.nome_fantasia),
      orientation: "h", type: "bar",
      customdata: filtered.map(c => c.documento),
      marker: {{color: colors}},
      hovertemplate: "<b>%{{y}}</b><br>Score de risco: %{{x}}<extra></extra>",
    }}], figData.layout, {{responsive: true, displaylogo: false}});
  }}

  function draw() {{
    if (!window.Plotly) {{ setTimeout(draw, 100); return; }}
    Plotly.newPlot("{bar_div}", figData.data, figData.layout, {{responsive: true, displaylogo: false}});
    const gd = document.getElementById("{bar_div}");

    gd.on("plotly_hover", (ev) => {{
      const doc = ev.points[0].customdata;
      window.__CURRENT_DOC__ = doc;
      if (window.updateClientCard) window.updateClientCard(doc);
      paintColors();
    }});
    gd.on("plotly_click", (ev) => {{
      const doc = ev.points[0].customdata;
      window.__CURRENT_DOC__ = doc;
      if (window.updateClientCard) window.updateClientCard(doc);
      paintColors();
    }});

    ["filterNome", "filterTpvMin", "filterTpvMax", "filterScoreMin", "filterScoreMax"].forEach(id => {{
      document.getElementById(id).addEventListener("input", redraw);
    }});
    redraw();
  }}
  draw();
}})();
</script>
'''))
```

```{python}
#| title: "Cliente selecionado"
card_div = "card_" + uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]
tpv_div = "tpv_" + uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]

display(HTML(f'''
<div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;">
  <div id="{card_div}"></div>
  <div id="{tpv_div}" style="width:100%;height:260px;"></div>
</div>

<script>
(function() {{
  const CARD_DIV = "{card_div}";
  const TPV_DIV = "{tpv_div}";
  const STONE_RED = "{STONE_RED}";
  const STONE_GRAY = "{STONE_GRAY}";

  function fmtBRL(v) {{
    if (v === null || v === undefined) return "—";
    return "R$ " + Number(v).toLocaleString("pt-BR", {{maximumFractionDigits: 0}});
  }}

  function buildEmail(c) {{
    const assunto = `[Risco de churn] Ação necessária — ${{c.nome_fantasia}}`;
    const corpo =
`Olá,

O cliente ${{c.nome_fantasia}} (documento ${{c.documento}}, ${{c.cidade}}/${{c.uf}}, rota ${{c.rota}}) está` +
` classificado como Top ${{c.rank}} em risco de churn para o próximo mês (score ${{c.risk_score}}/100).

Resumo:
- Dias sem transacionar: ${{c.dias_sem_transacionar}}
- Queda de TPV (3m vs. atual): ${{c.queda_tpv_pct !== null ? c.queda_tpv_pct + "%" : "n/d"}}
- TPV do mês atual: ${{fmtBRL(c.tpv_m0)}}
- Tempo de casa: ${{c.tempo_casa_anos}} anos
- Segmento: ${{c.mcc}}
- Canais já utilizados: ${{c.canais_historico.join(", ")}}

Recomenda-se iniciar contato ativo com o cliente o quanto antes.

— Radar de Churn (protótipo)`;
    return {{assunto, corpo}};
  }}

  window.showEmptyCard = function() {{
    document.getElementById(CARD_DIV).innerHTML = `
      <div style="font-size:1.15rem;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:4px;">Nenhum cliente selecionado</div>
      <div style="font-size:0.85rem;color:#888;margin-bottom:14px;">Passe o mouse ou clique em uma barra do ranking (ou use os filtros acima) para ver os detalhes aqui.</div>
      <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:8px;margin-bottom:10px;">
        <div><div style="font-size:0.72rem;color:#888;">Score de risco</div><div style="font-size:1.3rem;font-weight:700;">—</div></div>
        <div><div style="font-size:0.72rem;color:#888;">Dias sem transacionar</div><div style="font-size:1.3rem;font-weight:700;">—</div></div>
        <div><div style="font-size:0.72rem;color:#888;">Queda de TPV (3m)</div><div style="font-size:1.3rem;font-weight:700;">—</div></div>
        <div><div style="font-size:0.72rem;color:#888;">Tempo de casa</div><div style="font-size:1.3rem;font-weight:700;">—</div></div>
      </div>
      <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:4px 18px;font-size:0.88rem;color:#888;">
        <div><b>Documento:</b> —</div>
        <div><b>Vendedor:</b> —</div>
        <div><b>Cidade/UF:</b> —</div>
        <div><b>Tipo de contrato:</b> —</div>
        <div><b>Rota:</b> —</div>
        <div><b>Antecipação (RAV):</b> —</div>
        <div><b>Segmento (MCC):</b> —</div>
        <div><b>TPV do mês atual:</b> —</div>
      </div>
    `;
    Plotly.react(TPV_DIV, [], {{
      template: "simple_white", height: 260,
      title: "TPV mensal (selecione um cliente)",
      margin: {{t: 40, l: 40, r: 10, b: 30}},
    }}, {{responsive: true, displaylogo: false}});
  }};

  window.updateClientCard = function(documento) {{
    const c = window.__CLIENTES__.find(x => x.documento === documento);
    if (!c) return;

    const canaisHtml = c.canais_historico.map(ch =>
      `<span style="display:inline-block;background:#F0F7F1;color:#2f6e3a;border-radius:999px;padding:2px 10px;margin:2px;font-size:0.78rem;">${{ch}}</span>`
    ).join("");

    document.getElementById(CARD_DIV).innerHTML = `
      <div style="font-size:1.15rem;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:6px;">#${{c.rank}} · ${{c.nome_fantasia}}</div>
      <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:8px;margin-bottom:10px;">
        <div><div style="font-size:0.72rem;color:#888;">Score de risco</div><div style="font-size:1.3rem;font-weight:700;color:${{STONE_RED}}">${{c.risk_score}}</div></div>
        <div><div style="font-size:0.72rem;color:#888;">Dias sem transacionar</div><div style="font-size:1.3rem;font-weight:700;">${{c.dias_sem_transacionar ?? "—"}}</div></div>
        <div><div style="font-size:0.72rem;color:#888;">Queda de TPV (3m)</div><div style="font-size:1.3rem;font-weight:700;">${{c.queda_tpv_pct !== null ? c.queda_tpv_pct + "%" : "—"}}</div></div>
        <div><div style="font-size:0.72rem;color:#888;">Tempo de casa</div><div style="font-size:1.3rem;font-weight:700;">${{c.tempo_casa_anos ?? "—"}} anos</div></div>
      </div>
      <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:4px 18px;font-size:0.88rem;margin-bottom:8px;">
        <div><b>Documento:</b> ${{c.documento}}</div>
        <div><b>Vendedor:</b> ${{c.vendedor}}</div>
        <div><b>Cidade/UF:</b> ${{c.cidade}}/${{c.uf}}</div>
        <div><b>Tipo de contrato:</b> ${{c.tipo_contrato ?? "—"}}</div>
        <div><b>Rota:</b> ${{c.rota}}</div>
        <div><b>Antecipação (RAV):</b> ${{c.cadastro_rav}}</div>
        <div><b>Segmento (MCC):</b> ${{c.mcc}}</div>
        <div><b>TPV do mês atual:</b> ${{fmtBRL(c.tpv_m0)}}</div>
      </div>
      <div style="font-size:0.8rem;color:#888;margin-bottom:4px;">Canais já utilizados (${{c.n_canais_historico}}):</div>
      <div style="margin-bottom:10px;">${{canaisHtml}}</div>
      <details style="margin-bottom:6px;">
        <summary style="cursor:pointer;font-weight:600;color:${{STONE_RED}};">📧 Preparar e-mail para o vendedor</summary>
        <div style="margin-top:8px;">
          <input id="vendorEmailInput" type="email" placeholder="vendedor@querostone.com.br"
            style="width:100%;padding:6px 10px;border:1px solid #ccc;border-radius:6px;margin-bottom:8px;box-sizing:border-box;">
          <pre id="emailPreview" style="white-space:pre-wrap;background:#F7F8F7;border-radius:8px;padding:10px;font-size:0.78rem;max-height:180px;overflow:auto;"></pre>
          <a id="mailtoBtn" href="#" style="display:inline-block;background:${{STONE_RED}};color:white;padding:6px 14px;border-radius:8px;text-decoration:none;font-size:0.85rem;">✉️ Abrir e-mail para o vendedor</a>
          <div style="font-size:0.72rem;color:#888;margin-top:4px;">Protótipo: abre seu cliente de e-mail com o texto pronto — não envia sozinho.</div>
        </div>
      </details>
    `;

    const {{assunto, corpo}} = buildEmail(c);
    document.getElementById("emailPreview").textContent = `Assunto: ${{assunto}}\\n\\n${{corpo}}`;
    const mailBtn = document.getElementById("mailtoBtn");
    function refreshMailto() {{
      const to = encodeURIComponent(document.getElementById("vendorEmailInput").value || "");
      mailBtn.href = `mailto:${{to}}?subject=${{encodeURIComponent(assunto)}}&body=${{encodeURIComponent(corpo)}}`;
    }}
    document.getElementById("vendorEmailInput").addEventListener("input", refreshMailto);
    refreshMailto();

    const meses = c.tpv_ytd.map(p => p.mes);
    const tpvs = c.tpv_ytd.map(p => p.tpv);
    const trace = {{
      x: meses, y: tpvs, mode: "lines+markers", type: "scatter",
      line: {{color: STONE_RED, width: 2.5}},
      hovertemplate: "%{{x}}<br>TPV: R$ %{{y:,.0f}}<extra></extra>",
    }};
    const layout = {{
      template: "simple_white", height: 260,
      title: `TPV mensal em ${{window.__ANO_YTD__}} (YTD)`,
      margin: {{t: 40, l: 40, r: 10, b: 30}},
      xaxis: {{type: "category"}},
      shapes: [{{type: "line", x0: 0, x1: 1, xref: "paper", y0: window.__MEDIA_TPV__, y1: window.__MEDIA_TPV__,
                 yref: "y", line: {{color: STONE_GRAY, dash: "dot"}}}}],
      annotations: [{{x: 0, xref: "paper", y: window.__MEDIA_TPV__, yref: "y", xanchor: "left",
                      text: "média da carteira ativa", showarrow: false, font: {{size: 10, color: "#888"}}}}],
    }};
    Plotly.react(TPV_DIV, [trace], layout, {{responsive: true, displaylogo: false}});
  }};

  function boot() {{
    if (!window.Plotly) {{ setTimeout(boot, 100); return; }}
    window.showEmptyCard();
  }}
  boot();
}})();
</script>
'''))
```
